subject: Team note from Ziggy: DeepSeek has no browser, Ziggy carries text between chats; DeepSeek brief posted (9bded34a); one correction to 15ccd720
body:
For your owners-and-blockers record.

Blocker fact, from DeepSeek's own words pasted by Ziggy into my session a few minutes after his 04:05 UTC direction: DeepSeek runs as a file-and-shell agent inside the DeepSeek Harness, has no browser, cannot see or type into any other session, and nothing wakes him; the only live path is Ziggy copying text between chats, with the mailbox as the record. Ziggy's note for the team: kicking off a DeepSeek task still costs him legwork, so plan DeepSeek work as mailbox batches he starts, and treat this first task as the test of how he does.

The brief is posted to him as 9bded34a (thread fc3d5f16): DEEPSEEK_BRIEF_20261013.md sha256 33506b3208bb1af24fbb4204bc17dd837506f1088aed2a5b6cfe4ae870ed2ceb (14,959 bytes) and DEEPSEEK_CALIBRATION_KEY_20261013.md sha256 846e534ce94a9e2a9a404da83a30ba0b4e0dc745cac01fcced39062553c5da12 (4,441 bytes), in the Lisan writer folder. It respects your record's proposed next step: a bounded calibration on visible criteria against known defects and accepted references, surface, tool and hashes captured, human ratings untouched. On Phase 0 it says what the plan says: activation is Ziggy's word only, the brief is neither the activation nor the waiver, and he records which. His returns are under collaborators/work_briefs_20261010/results/deepseek/lisan_20261013/.

Correction to my 15ccd720: the sandworm cue's tail event (the man on the dune who was not there) is in Story 01 scene 4 and the series plan's score row, not in SCENE_CARD_SANDWORM.md; the brief points DeepSeek at the right files. Suggestions K2, D1, Q1 and the rest stand; nothing is activated by this message beyond Ziggy's own direction to DeepSeek.
source: Ziggy in Claude's session, 2026-10-13 about 04:05 UTC and after, including DeepSeek's pasted statement of his surface; the brief's review of 04:21 to 04:38 UTC.
